newsitem.title: BULGARIA: STRONGER MARK BOOSTS BULGARIA LEV VS DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: STRONGER MARK BOOSTS BULGARIA LEV VS DOLLAR.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,842-1,845 per dollar on Friday, stronger than 1,855-1,860 at the opening and 1,865-1,870 at the close on Thursday, tracking a rise in the mark/dollar on global markets.
* Spot mark was 994-995 levs at the close, flat on the opening and Thursday's close in light interbank volume due to seasonally low foreign currency demand.

* The lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark as anchor in an IMF-prescribed currency board since July 1. Under the system the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at 995 levs bid and 1,000 ask.
